deposit.n1: Kindly please check for the latest active deposit bank details before you making a deposit.
deposit.n2: For using Bank Transfer deposit option, please make the transfer done before submit the transaction to avoid the transaction delay.
deposit.n3: Depositor's ACCOUNT NAME must match with your registered full name. We do not encourage transaction made using 3rd party/company account.
deposit.n4: Please DO NOT fill in 'VUI123' or any sensitive words related to gambling as reference/remark in your online transaction.
deposit.n5: Please take noted that will be 1x rollover required for all deposit made before any withdrawal can be processed.
deposit.n6: Kindly please contact our 24/7 LIVECHAT if your transaction is still pending for more than 5 minutes.

rewards.n1: Games that are NOT eligible for the Rebate/Commission include: Turnover on all types of non-live table games (e.g. Blackjack, Video Poker, Craps, American Roulette, Baccarat, and other non-live table games) and non-slot games, will not count towards this turnover requirement unless SPECIFICALLY stated.
rewards.n3: [Sportsbookl] Only wagers that generate a win/loss return will entitle for rebate. Cancelled or void wagers, wagers on odds less than 1.7 (Decimal odd); 0.7 (China odd); 0.7 (Malay Positive odd); -1.43 (Indo odd); -143 (US odd), or wagers on both even chances during a single game will not entitle for rebate.
rewards.n4: [Live Casino] All LIVE Blackjack (21) and Live Roulette video games
rewards.n5: [Slots] All Video Poker, Table, Arcade, Fishing, multi-spin Slots, Lucky God Progressive 2, Golden Tour, Ugga Bugga, Liu Fu Shou, and double-bonus Slots offered by any slot game room, plus games in xx slot game rooms.
rewards.n6: *Notes: Rewards rule of the company will change from time to time, In any event, the decision of Vui123 is final.

topUpCard.n1: Please ensure you choose the correct telco provider and card value. Vui123 do not bear any responsibility if incorrect information selected and resulted the lost of money
topUpCard.n2: The final deposited amount is subject to 25% deduction from the original card value.

transfer.n1: All the fund receive via internal transfer are subject to |1x rollover| before the withdrawal

withdrawal.n1: Kindly check with our 24/7 LIVE CHAT if your transaction is pending for more than 10 minutes.
withdrawal.n2: Withdrawal bank account name must match with registered full name, member is not allow withdrawal to 3rd party bank account.
withdrawal.n3: Some game provider requires 15 till 30 minutes of report sync time, kindly bear with us during the required sync time.
withdrawal.n4: Please make sure your required turnover is achieve, and submit the withdrawal transaction after 30 minutes to avoid system auto reject.
withdrawal.n5: If there is any discrepancy or you may have any other further withdrawal inquiries, kindly contact our 24/7 LIVE CHAT. Thank you.
